response.justification: The candidate is technically an excellent match on skills — strong TypeScript/Node.js, React exposure, Kubernetes, AWS, and even LLM/MCP agent tooling experience covering nearly all nice-to-haves. However, with roughly 18 years of experience including Staff and Senior titles, he is significantly overqualified for an entry-level junior/mid position, raising serious concerns about compensation expectations, retention, and role fit.
strengths: Deep TypeScript/Node.js fullstack experience across multiple production platforms
Covers nearly all nice-to-haves: LLM/API integration, Kubernetes, AWS, DevOps
Strong software craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, clean architecture advocacy)
concerns: Heavily overqualified for an entry-level role; likely salary and retention mismatch
No explicit PostgreSQL or Nest.js experience (MongoDB/MySQL instead)
Currently employed as Staff Engineer — unclear motivation for a junior position
